# Captured public source XML

Retrieved over verified HTTPS from https://media.election.net.nz/xml/ on 6 November 2026. Source timestamp: 2026-11-06T16:19:53 (NZDT). Files are unchanged source captures; `e01.xml` comes from `e01/e01.xml`. Source owner: Electoral Commission New Zealand. These contain directory entries and zero counts, not election-night results.

The unit tests make explicitly synthetic in-memory mutations to exercise nonzero, malformed, old, test-marked and inconsistent responses. They are never shipped as application results. Runtime smoke tests use these captures by default. Feed permission, test/election identity and publishing requirements must be checked separately before production counts are activated.
